title: Aerodynamic challenges in running: Understanding headwind and tailwind effects
claims: 数值模拟中，30 km/h 顺风约降低 9% 能量消耗，同速逆风约增加 37%。
风速与方向改变跑者身后的湍流尾迹，从而改变代谢功率需求。
逆风的代价明显大于同速顺风的收益。

verification.note: PDF 正文与 Table 1 可读。

claimVerification.note: 摘要："30 km/h tailwind leads to a modest 9% reduction… headwind of the same speed results in a substantial 37% increase"。
摘要："alter the turbulent wake behind the runner, ultimately affecting metabolic power requirements"。
摘要："temporary tailwind advantages do not sufficiently offset headwind effects"。
